name: markdownlint
description:
The markdownlint configuration is set to use the default rule set and extends the standard “markdownlint:recommended” collection. The Textrise plugin is enabled to provide additional checks, while rule MD001 has been deliberately turned off.

For the remaining rules, MD002 is configured to raise a warning on any violation. MD013 enforces a maximum line length of 120 characters (with headings limited to 80 characters) and does not apply this limit inside code blocks; any breach is treated as an error. MD031 also produces warnings, whereas MD041 flags breaches as errors.
